description: This file defines the WinDnsSystemSettings structure and related functions for representing and retrieving Windows DNS system configuration, including DNS addresses, search lists, devolution settings, and policies.

classes.name: WinDnsSystemSettings
classes.description: Represents Windows DNS configuration including addresses, search lists, devolution settings, and policies.

classes.name: WinDnsSystemSettings::DevolutionSetting
classes.description: Encapsulates devolution configuration with optional enabled and level parameters.

methods.name: WinDnsSystemSettings::IsStatelessDiscoveryAddress
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is a DNS address from IPv6 stateless discovery.

methods.name: WinDnsSystemSettings::GetAllNameservers
methods.description: Retrieves all configured DNS nameservers, excluding stateless discovery addresses.

methods.name: ReadWinSystemDnsSettings
methods.description: Reads DNS system settings from Windows registry and IpHelper, returning an optional configuration object.
